text:
jen: deploy-bot just posted post-deploy smoke for v2.14.2 — 5/6 probes ok, 1 failing (modelproxy 503) in ap-southeast-2. holding further shards for AP.

deploy-bot: POST-DEPLOY SUMMARY v2.14.2:
- synthetic/health: ok
- kv-warmup: ok
- embed-p95: normal
- modelproxy/errors: 1 failing probe -> mp-503-ap2
logs excerpt: ```2026-03-22T02:10:11Z ERROR modelproxy 503 backend=mv-gamma host=host-250 req=xyz123```

ops_chris: i'm on call. grabbing host-250 logs and memstat.

sara: any recent mv swaps in AP?

deploy-bot: mv-swap recorded: mv-gamma on host-group-ap-2 at 2026-03-22T02:05:30Z by release-manager.

ops_chris: host-250 mem cgroup shows limit breached (cgroup=14GiB limit=14GiB) + slow unloads. likely memory pressure from mv-gamma.

jen: propose targeted action: 1) pin host-group-ap-2 routing back to previous modelvariant, 2) drain host-250 and restart modelproxy, 3) keep AP shards paused.

sara: +1. add increased probe frequency (10s) on that group to validate.

ops_chris: running: `rbctl pin --group host-group-ap-2 --version v2.14.1 --reason "modelproxy 503/memory pressure"` then `hostctl drain host-250 --timeout 90s` then `systemctl restart redwood-modelproxy`.

ops_chris: pin applied, drain started.

deploy-bot: reroute complete for pinned group; follow-up probes scheduled.

ops_chris: restart done. follow-up probe mp-503-ap2 -> OK. embed p95 stable.

jen: good. keep pin for 12 hours and open infra ticket to bisect mv-gamma mem increase.

sara: i'll add changelog note: "post-deploy: targeted pin in AP after modelproxy 503s; host restarted; monitoring extended."

release-manager: added to release calendar and opened ticket INFRA-3421. resuming rollout for non-AP shards.

ops_chris: marking this issue resolved for now. will reopen if probes regress.

jen: thanks team. continuing rollout except AP region which remains pinned until follow-up.
